plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 8th house: powerful sexual and physical charge - magnetic, consuming, intense. Failure mode: power games, jealousy, intensity tipping into control or conflict over shared resources. Let it be passionate; watch the power and keep it clean and consensual.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
